availability.note: Release calendar (2026-09-06, rights reported): “Bigg Boss Kannada 13” streams on JioHotstar. JioHotstar: sold with Xstream Play Premium (₹279 card and prepaid packs) — ₹279/month Xstream Premium ('24 OTTs'; terms: '25+ OTT @ Rs 279'); prepaid all-in-one packs ₹279 / ₹598 / ₹1,729. Hotstar / Disney+ Hotstar and JioCinema (which absorbed Voot) now stream as JioHotstar. Bundle tier: JioHotstar Super (FHD, 2 screens). Prepaid pack prices last confirmed 2025-05-27.
